title: Fort Langley Film & Television Self-Guided Audio Walking Tour
includes: No time constraints, take as long as you like to complete the tour
Download on WIFI before (no signal required or data used during tour)
Live GPS map shows route & your location
Flexible dates - tour is yours to keep and enjoy anytime
Tour guide commentary automatically plays at each point of interest
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
**Recommended attractions may be closed/inaccessible due to season or circumstances beyond our control.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Fort Langley’s screen-famous streets on a flexible GPS-guided audio walking tour. Stories play automatically as you follow the village route past recognizable filming locations, heritage buildings, shops and riverfront scenery.

Highlights include FORT LANGLEY COMMUNITY HALL, TRADING POST EATERY, FORT LANGLEY CN STATION, MARINA PARK, ST. ANDREW’S CHAPEL and the historic GLOVER ROAD streetscape. Hear behind-the-scenes stories from movies and television filmed here, along with local history and folklore.

Start whenever you like, pause for photos, shops or refreshments and finish at your own pace. Download before you arrive; no mobile data or signal is needed during the tour.
